rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of national/regional/state/local veterinary medical or vet-tech associations, federal or state agencies, accredited colleges, associations in the AVMA or NAVTA directory, AVMA-accredited vet schools/vet-tech programs, AAVSB RACE-approved programs, comparable foreign providers; online, video, audio, correspondence and interactive distance courses accepted
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal after initial issuance of the license.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement at renewal; keep CE records 5 years; board may audit the preceding biennium.
rules.notes: 30 h (50-minute hours) per biennium, at least 25 h scientific and at least 25 h documented by an approved provider; publications/presentations max 15 h. Credentials renew before December 31 of odd-numbered years.
rules.rule_quote: (1) (a) Except as provided in subs. (2) and (3), a veterinarian shall complete at least 30 hours of continuing education pertinent to veterinary medicine in each biennial renewal period.
